messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGE: Elevated tail latency and sporadic 504s from run endpoint (/v1/run) across eu-central-1. Alert rule: tail_latency_p99 > 2.5s for 5m. Pager: ops-oncall

ops-oncall: i'm on it. p99 jumped from ~1.1s to ~3.6s around 07:22 UTC. looking at traces now.

rafael: saw a bunch of retries and a few 504s in the logs, seems correlated with a subset of model variants that are larger (quantized-16). traces show long blocking on disk reads during kv restore.

deploy-bot: note: model-serving pool rolled out variant bundle v3.7 at 06:50 UTC (commit ef45be).

kim: checking node metrics  there are spikes in i/o wait and high page cache churn on nodes serving quantized-16. suspect change in model artifact packaging caused more shard reads at startup.

jordan: customer impact: two customers reported timeouts: finledger (enterprise) and corpus-research (hosted). CS notified. finledger is reporting degraded batch inference jobs.

ops-oncall: mitigation options: 1) re-route traffic from quantized-16 variants to quantized-8 compatible variants for bursty routes, 2) increase prefetch/concurrency limits on those nodes, 3) pause further rollout of v3.7. recommending 1+3 now.

rafael: starting traffic re-route with feature-flag. will pin high-volume routes to q8 variants.

kim: pausing rollout in control plane for v3.7 now.

ops-oncall: after re-route, p99 stabilized to ~1.2s and 504s dropped to near-zero within 6 minutes.

deploy-bot: rollout paused by kim at 07:35 UTC.

jordan: CS update: finledger reports their batch window completed with retries but saw 14 failures during the spike; they requested a root-cause and whether this could hit dedicated capacity.

ops-oncall: handing off to day crew. we should schedule a postmortem and assemble timeline + customers affected. incident-bot: POST-INCIDENT: please schedule postmortem within 72h and add severity tag.

rafael: i'll run postmortem. proposed time: 2026-04-07 13:00 UTC. creating ticket INF-2567 and attaching traces + node profiles.

kim: initial RCA hypothesis: model bundle v3.7 changed packaging layout increasing random-read pressure on cold cache, causing increased disk i/o and blocking during model artifact restores. also missing a startup prefetch step that used to be enabled for q16.

rafael: draft action items (owners, sized, quarter tie-in):
- AI-1: Revert packaging change or add streaming prefetch for q16 bundles; include integration test to validate cold-start tail latency. owner: rafael. size: M. quarter: Q2 reliability.
- AI-2: Add a deployment CI gate that runs a lightweight cold-start benchmark for model bundle changes (automated). owner: kim. size: S. quarter: immediate (pre-release safety).
- AI-3: Expand routing policies to prefer lower-i/o variants during detected cold-cache windows; implement an automated soft-fallback. owner: ops-oncall. size: M. quarter: Q2 product ops.
- AI-4: Create per-customer SLA sentinel checks for enterprise customers (finledger) to trigger immediate paging and dedicated fallback when batch job failures exceed threshold. owner: cs-rep + platform. size: L. quarter: Q3 enterprise reliability.
- AI-5: Run a focused chaos test simulating cold model restores with varying artifact layouts and storage backends. owner: jordan. size: M. quarter: Q2 experiments.

kim: i'll take AI-2, should be able to ship a CI job and dashboard in 2 dev-days.

rafael: AI-1 i'll scope: if packaging revert is low-risk we'll do a hotfix, otherwise add prefetch at runtime. estimate 3 dev-days for fix + tests.

ops-oncall: prioritization: severity P2 (partial degradation with enterprise impact). recommend AI-2 as P0 (block further bundle rollout), AI-1 P0/P1 depending on revert risk, AI-3 P1 for next sprint, AI-4 P2 with product onboarding alignment.

jordan: adding customer comms: drafting a targeted postmortem for finledger and corpus-research, cc'ing account managers.

cs-rep: CS will coordinate outreach and share temporary mitigation guidance (retry/backoff + pinned variants). asking platform to provide pinned-variant urls for finledger by EOD.

ops-oncall: i'll also add instrumentation: disk i/o wait alerts on model-restore nodes and an automated flag when cold-start p99 exceeds 2s for >3m. small infra change, marking as S.

incident-bot: NOTE: include linking to INF-2567 ticket and label severity:P2. Postmortem meeting link: https://zoom.example.com/pm-1854003210 (scheduled).

rafael: added retrospective checklist to INF-2567 and created AI issues in the backlog with labels: severity:P2, quarter:Q2/Q3.

kim: final action: will block v3.7 rollout until AI-2 CI gate is in place.

jordan: wrap-up: thanks for quick mitigation. please update INF-2567 with progress on AI tickets and estimate completion dates.

ops-oncall: last_message_ts=1854006800

cs-rep: :white_check_mark: thanks team.
